**What changes, and why.**

- [ ] `ruff check . && ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] If the schema changed: `README.md` and `AGENTS.md` updated (the doc tests
      will tell you), and a `CHANGELOG.md` entry added.
- [ ] If an invariant in `CONTRIBUTING.md` is affected, say which and why.
